errors.text: The proposed Mo-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No explicit alloy composition or Mo-content range is defined, so the required density below 6 g/cm3 cannot be checked; adding dense Mo may jeopardize that constraint.
The cited evidence concerns FeCoCrNi-based coatings and Al-Ti-Zr-Nb-Mo alloys rather than previously reported Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloys.
The claim that Mo reduces hard intermetallic formation is not supported by E1, which instead identifies Mo concentration as a key factor in forming a hard sigma-CrMo phase.
No numerical processing temperature, oxidation temperature, exposure time, or composition boundaries are supplied.
The falsification experiment lacks quantitative controls and acceptance criteria, making its rule largely tautological.
